skill_title: Skill Self-Improvement — Layer 1 runtime + monitor/triage + Layer 2 offline optimizer for Pi skills
skill_description: Two-layer self-improvement for Pi skills: Layer 1 runtime skill_manage extension (every skill write gated by an accumulated-experience bar and the user's approval; a new skill must also pass skill-forge's lint gate) with per-skill usage telemetry, a session-end triage digest and a prompt suggestion naming the next target, a monitor/triage step that ranks which skill to evolve first, and Layer 2 offline DSPy+GEPA optimization of SKILL.md bodies, constraint-gated, human-reviewed.

layer1.role: runtime learning — the skill_manage Pi extension + per-skill usage telemetry
layer1.companion_doc: layer1/agents-routing-section.md (copy of the global instruction file §7)

gates: accumulated-experience bar (evolution/monitor/evidence.py) — revise needs breadth (>=2 sessions) AND a deficiency signal (revisits/failures/proposals); create needs the same need proposed in >=2 independent sessions
user approval (ctx.ui.confirm; no UI = fail closed)
skill-forge lint gate (new skills only, staged in a temp dir)

session_end_digest.command: python -m evolution.monitor.triage --json (stdlib only, no venv needed)
session_end_digest.cost: zero model calls; read-only (never evolves, never merges)

suggestion.computed: once per session (session_start), refreshed at most every PI_SKILL_SUGGEST_REFRESH_MIN minutes
suggestion.injected_into: the skill_memory prompt section at before_agent_start
suggestion.policy: pointer only — the agent acts only on a user request, behind the dry-run + ask-user cost gate

monitor.role: triage — rank skills by usage x potential, print the next action
monitor.note: fills the slot upstream Hermes leaves as a placeholder (Phase 5 auto-triage)

layer2.role: offline evolution — DSPy+GEPA optimizer over SKILL.md bodies
layer2.command_gate: bin/smoke-candidate (opt-in via --smoke): runs the candidate's allowlisted shell commands and rejects one whose commands break

evidence.role: the accumulated-experience bar — what makes a skill write a conclusion rather than a reflex
evidence.revise_bar: breadth (use_sessions >= 2) AND a deficiency signal (revisits >= 3 in one session, failures >= 1, or proposal_sessions >= 2)
evidence.create_bar: the same need proposed in >= 2 independent sessions
